source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Go to the inspections search. Inspects can be filtered by inspection type, then by year.
3. Export all records with a type of "Accessibility Stand-Alone", filtered by the desired date range.
4. This will produce a csv file with the records.
5. From that, filter to the rows where the outcome is "Failed"
6. Take all the address strings from the csv file containing the failed records and set them to the addresses property of the [search-accessibility-reports](src/search-accessibility-reports) component.
7. Run the app.
8. Compare the results to the audit results to ensure they align.
